title: Cleaning Checklist Weekly Checklist Time Trend
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cleaning:checklist checklist_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(checklist_minutes) as avg_duration, max(checklist_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst checklist time for cleaning checklist events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture checklist_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average checklist time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether cleaning checklist tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
